title: metadata: the cached /meta item read sends Last-Modified as the time of the read, not of the item, so the header carries no information
body:
domain:server#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2dLQEXWGsE2SZ3Qn5F

Filing gate: ① product defect (an HTTP cache header that states something false), found while fixing #31171 (PR #31195, dev hand-off; the flake's cause). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.
Reader: the seat that owns `packages/metadata-protocol` (`protocol-search-and-cache.ts`) and `packages/rest` (`meta-item-read-routes.ts`).
Dedupe (open AND closed): `Last-Modified meta` → 4 hits, the only related one is #31171 (the flake this causes in a test, fixed in the test only).
reach: every cached `GET /api/v1/meta/:type/:name`; read from the code on `main`, observed in queue builds 42383103865 and 42385456389 (two reads of one unchanged item answered `Last-Modified` one second apart).
class: c · type: Bug

## 维护者速读

元数据接口的缓存响应里，`Last-Modified` 填的是「这次读取的时间」，不是条目真正最后修改的时间。所以这个头没有任何信息：同一条没改过的元数据，两次读到的值不一样；按 `If-Modified-Since` 做的缓存校验永远判成「已修改」。现在缓存靠 ETag 正常工作，所以没坏功能，但这个头在说假话，今天还让一个测试在合并队列里抖了两次（#31171）。

## What is wrong

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-search-and-cache.ts` ~147 returns `lastModified: new Date().toISOString()` beside the item's content `etag`.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-routes.ts` ~974 renders it as `Last-Modified`. Two reads of an unchanged item a second apart answer different `Last-Modified` values with the same `ETag`.

## Expected

- `Last-Modified` is the item's own last change (its stored `updated_at` / publish time) when the protocol knows it, or the header is omitted when it does not — never the read time. Freshness stays gated by the ETag (`no-cache`), unchanged.

Acceptance: two reads of one unchanged item answer the same `Last-Modified` (or none); a publish moves it.
